About Blue Wave Infra

Waterpark solutions and civil construction, under one roof.

We bring together waterpark slide manufacturing, civil engineering, construction and project coordination for waterparks, swimming pools, resorts, hotels and recreational developments. From a single installation to a complete park, every solution is tailored to the client's requirements, site conditions and budget.

🎯 Mission

To deliver dependable waterpark and civil construction solutions through engineering-focused planning, quality workmanship, innovative thinking and customer-oriented execution.

🧭 Vision

To become a trusted name in waterpark infrastructure and civil construction, creating high-quality recreational spaces and long-lasting infrastructure.

  • 🧩Integrated solutionsAttractions and civil construction in one coordinated approach
  • 🎯Customer-focused planningTailored to project needs and budgets
  • 🏅Quality commitmentWorkmanship, materials and construction standards
  • 📏Practical executionAttention to site conditions and coordination
  • 🤝Reliable partnershipClear communication throughout the project
  • ♾️Long-term valueDurability, functionality and customer satisfaction

    How a project runs

    Five stages, one accountable team.

    From the first discussion to execution and handover, design, manufacturing and site crews work as one team with one point of contact.

    📍STAGE 1

    Survey & consultancy

    Site survey, your brief and budget, and a first estimate for the project.

    📐STAGE 2

    Master layout & 3D design

    Concept master plan, 3D designs of every attraction, and structural drawings.

    🏭STAGE 3

    Manufacturing

    Slides, play towers and equipment produced and checked in our production unit.

    🏗️STAGE 4

    Turnkey execution

    Civil work, plumbing and electrical, equipment installation, filtration, changing rooms and interiors.

    🤝STAGE 5

    Handover & support

    Testing, commissioning and handover, with maintenance access planned in from the start.
